# Vulnerabilities govulncheck reports as reachable from SAGE's own code, which
# have been reviewed and accepted. Anything NOT listed here fails CI.
#
# Format: <OSV ID>  # why it is accepted
#
# Review these whenever a dependency moves. An entry that gains a fix upstream
# should be removed from this file and fixed, not left here.

GO-2026-5932  # x/crypto/openpgp is unmaintained with no fix. Reached only by ring-go's package init (armor.init) — SAGE never calls openpgp.
GO-2026-6170  # lib/pq. No fix. Arrives via shannon-sdk -> poktroll/app -> cosmos-sdk/server -> cometbft/node. Reachable only through an io.Closer interface; SAGE opens no SQL connection.
GO-2026-6172  # lib/pq, same provenance and same reasoning as GO-2026-6170.
GO-2026-6173  # lib/pq, same provenance and same reasoning as GO-2026-6170.
GO-2023-1821  # cosmos-sdk x/crisis. No fix exists. Chain-side module semantics reached only by package init; a gateway evaluates no consensus logic.
GO-2023-1881  # cosmos-sdk x/crisis, same reasoning as GO-2023-1821.
